decisionSupport.rationale: Complete regular and runoff canvass reports expose explicit observed and unobserved district-event rows without resolving how nonstandard absences enter the evaluator.

limitations: These official canvass reports establish exact event-scoped candidate totals; they do not by themselves bind source candidate names or source incumbent markers to current production identities.
The source reports contain no winner marker. No winner is inferred from vote totals or canvass percentages.

Regular-primary and runoff contests are retained as separate events. A matching cycle, party, and district records only a relationship candidate and never substitutes the runoff for the regular primary or selects either result.
A district absent from a retained official canvass report remains not observed with its disposition unresolved; absence is never converted into zero votes, no candidate, uncontested, or no runoff.
The retained Official Canvass Report PDFs are not independently bound to a separate signed, sealed, or statutory final-certification authority in this receipt.
Historical district geography, candidate ideology, progressive classification, identity, evaluator integration, human review, and publication remain unresolved.
